shortDescription: Manage phoenixNAP Bare Metal Cloud clusters

options.name: ca_certificate
options.description: The SSL CA certificate to be used for rancher admin. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: certificate
options.description: The SSL certificate to be used for rancher admin. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: certificate_key
options.description: The SSL certificate key to be used for rancher admin. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: client_id
options.description: Client ID (Application Management)

options.name: client_secret
options.description: Client Secret (Application Management)

options.name: cluster_domain
options.description: This maps to ranchers cluster-domain. Cluster Domain. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: description
options.description: Cluster description. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: etcd_snapshot_retention
options.description: This maps to ranchers etcd-snapshot-retention. Number of snapshots to retain. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook Default is 5

options.name: etcd_snapshot_schedule_cron
options.description: This maps to ranchers etcd-snapshot-schedule-cron. Snapshot interval time in cron spec. eg. every 5 hours Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook Default is '* */12 * * *'

options.name: location
options.description: Deployment location. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: name
options.description: Cluster name.

options.name: node_install_default_keys
options.description: Define whether public keys marked as default should be installed on this node. These are public keys that were already recorded on this system. Use GET /ssh-keys to retrieve a list of possible values. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook deafult is true

options.name: node_key_ids
options.description: List of public SSH key identifiers. These are public keys that were already recorded on this system. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: node_keys
options.description: List of public SSH keys. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: node_pool_count
options.description: Number of configured nodes, currently only node counts of 1 and 3 are possible. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: node_pool_name
options.description: The name of the node pool. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: node_server_type
options.description: Node server type. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook default is s0.d1.small

options.name: node_taint
options.description: This maps to ranchers node-taint. Registering kubelet with set of taints. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the cluster.

options.name: tls_san
options.description: This maps to ranchers tls-san. Add additional hostname or IP as a Subject Alternative Name in the TLS cert. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: token
options.description: Shared secret used to join a server or agent to a cluster. Once a cluster is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: workload_configuration
options.description: Workload cluster configuration parameters.
